Internet Packet Architecture

Data sent over the internet is chunked into discrete Packets. Each packet contains headers (IP addresses, ports, sequence numbers) and payload data.

OSI & TCP/IP Model Stack

  • Layer 7 Application: HTTP, DNS, TLS
  • Layer 4 Transport: TCP (Reliable), UDP (Fast)
  • Layer 3 Network: IP Routing, TTL, ICMP
  • Layer 2 Link: Ethernet MAC, Frame Delivery

Interactive Features

  • • Drag nodes around to rearrange network topology
  • • Click "Sever Fiber Link" to force BGP dynamic dynamic rerouting
  • • Click any moving packet particle to view packet raw header
